name: gamenet_wait_for_local_player_color_index
description: GameNet::WaitForLocalPlayerColorIndex polls DirectPlay receive processing until the local player has a positive color index or the wait budget expires.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent GameNet/zNetwork receive-startup source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4320b0 validates the maxWaitSeconds loop, ReceivePendingMessages(-1), zNetwork::GetLocalPlayerColorIndex positive-return gate, Sleep(1000) between failed polls, and zero return when the wait budget is exhausted.
The native GameNet wait smoke verifies the zero-wait return and the successful positive local-color return after receive polling.
